state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 7 (writes and passwords): `add`, `modify`, `delete`, `rename` and `Ldap\Change` are on `main`, and passwords and `compare` are the stage's open items.** Stages 1 to 5 are done, and Stage 4 is done except for a CA that a program supplies. Stage 6 is done except wiring the schema into the readers. Of Stage 7's checks, `modify_applies_its_changes_in_one_request`, `typed_values_round_trip_through_a_write` and `tests/conformance/core/ldap-add-modify-delete-rename.nvst` pass against `samba-ad`; the four password and compare tests and `ldap-set-password.nvst` are not written.

**On `main`**: everything Stage 6 listed, plus `nvs_ldap::Connection::modify`/`add`/`delete`/`rename`/`compare` (one request each, `proto::Op::Written`/`Compared`), `nvs_ldap::value::filetime_text`/`interval_text`/`boolean_text`/`flag_text`, and `crate::ldap::write` (the Novis bodies and `encoded`, the value table). An `Instant` is written as a GeneralizedTime where the schema gives the attribute that syntax and as a FILETIME otherwise, so `encoded` reads the schema only when it meets an `Instant`. `Connection::compare` exists on the wire and has no Novis member yet. Result 16 (`noSuchAttribute`) is now `ConstraintViolation`.

Server cases reach `samba-ad` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`) at `ldaps://localhost:16636`. Write cases add and delete their own `OU=` entries at the domain root, and each case and test uses its own names (`Shop`/`Blog`/`Store`, `Staff`/`Team`, `Framework`, `Example`) because the cases run at the same time.

items.text: **`setPassword`/`changePassword` over `unicodePwd`, encrypted only** (ADR 0278 § 9). `setPassword` is one `replace` of `unicodePwd`, `changePassword` one Modify with `remove` old plus `add` new, each value the quoted password in UTF-16LE. Both refuse before sending when `Connection::is_encrypted` at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs:334` is false, whatever the cleartext grant says, as `EncryptionRequired`. AD's `data 52D` already maps to `PasswordPolicy` in `crates/nvs-ldap/src/error.rs`. The bodies go beside `nvs_core_ldap_connection_modify` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/write.rs:345`, the rows beside `rename` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:404`. Closes `set_password_and_change_password_use_unicode_pwd`, `a_password_write_on_an_unencrypted_connection_is_refused`, `a_password_policy_refusal_is_its_own_kind` and `tests/conformance/core/ldap-set-password.nvst`. Samba needs a user for this: add one under `CN=Users` in the test and delete it after.

**`compare(Dn|string, string $attribute, mixed $value): bool`** (ADR 0278 § 9). `nvs_ldap::Connection::compare` is written; the Novis body encodes the value with `encoded` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/write.rs:132`. Closes `compare_returns_a_bool_and_throws_on_error`.

**The readers take the base type from the schema** (`rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`), Stage 6's last item. `crate::ldap::schema` is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs:606`; an `Ldap\Entry` cannot reach its connection, so either it carries the key or `search` reads the schema when it builds the entry.

backlog: A server round trip for a `Uuid`, a `Sid`, an `Instant` and a `Duration` through `modify`: the OU entries the cases use have no writable attribute of those syntaxes (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/write.rs` module doc).
A CA that a program supplies to `Ldap::open` (Stage 4, ADR 0278 § 2).
Stage 9's Global Catalog `ReadOnly` refusal goes in `crate::ldap::write` before a byte is sent (ADR 0278 § 11).
